title: Simulator-Refined Diffusion for Radio-Frequency Inverse Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.38363v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have shown potential in inverse design of printed circuit boards (PCBs), enabling the generation of layouts conditioned on target S-parameters. Despite this promise, applying diffusion models to PCB layout generation remains challenging due to their difficulty in meeting the quantitative electromagnetic specifications. A common approach is gradient-based guidance, which biases the diffusion sampling process with the gradient of an objective used for evaluation. However, full-wave electromagnetic simulators are accurate but expensive and typically non-differentiable, whereas differentiable surrogates are informative but not always reliable. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD), a novel combination of a low-fidelity differentiable surrogate and a high-fidelity non-differentiable simulator within the diffusion sampling process. translated_title: 面向射频逆向设计的模拟器精炼扩散模型
translated_abstract: 扩散模型在印刷电路板（PCB）的逆向设计中展现出潜力，能够根据目标S参数条件生成布局。尽管前景可观，但将扩散模型应用于PCB布局生成仍面临挑战，原因在于扩散模型难以满足定量的电磁规格指标。一种常见的方法是基于梯度的引导，即利用用于评估的目标函数的梯度来偏置扩散采样过程。然而，全波电磁仿真器虽然精确但计算成本高昂，且通常不可微分；而可微分的代理模型虽然信息丰富，但并不总是可靠。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了模拟器精炼扩散（SRD）方法，这是一种在扩散采样过程中将低保真可微分代理模型与高保真不可微分仿真器相结合的新型方法。与标准的零阶优化不同，它……
tldr: 提出模拟器精炼扩散（SRD）方法，在扩散采样过程中将低保真可微分代理模型与高保真不可微分全波电磁仿真器相结合，以解决扩散模型在PCB射频逆向设计中难以满足定量电磁规格的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD), which combines a low-fidelity differentiable surrogate with a high-fidelity non-differentiable full-wave electromagnetic simulator within the diffusion sampling process to generate PCB layouts that meet quantitative electromagnetic specifications in radio-frequency inverse design.
